current_parent_critical_path.objective: Implement and qualify the deterministic synthetic cross-component Book authoring harness using only existing qualified public APIs and the newly A-01-qualified lifecycle rebind sidecar. Preserve one persistent lifecycle ledger across every non-lifecycle parent successor.
non_negotiable_harness_rules: Do not reset or manually rewrite the persistent lifecycle ledger after a non-lifecycle parent successor; use BOOK-SYSTEM-LIFECYCLE-CURRENT-PARENT-REBIND-001.
Do not add a new Book runtime engine to make the harness pass.
Synthetic author/provider/publication fixtures must be explicitly labeled as synthetic qualification evidence and must never be represented as real author consent or publication authorization.
Document generation/rendering/conversion/validation mechanics remain outside Book System.
Technical export/proof/provenance/C2PA success and EXPORT_FROZEN do not authorize publication.
Any discovered composition gap pauses the harness at that exact seam for bounded repair; do not hide it with test-only mutation.

generic_continue_rule: In Book System control, Continue executes BOOK-SYSTEM-END-TO-END-AUTHORING-QUALIFICATION-001-HARNESS-001. If hosted qualification passes, bind the final wrapper, requalify the exact final SHA, register the qualification through shared A-01 control, run A-01, and close only on exact-SHA authoritative PASS.
